blocks.content: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is a statutory body established to protect and promote human rights in India. Human rights include the rights to life, liberty, equality, and dignity guaranteed by the Constitution.
The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is a statutory body established to protect and promote human rights in India.

items: NHRC is a statutory body (created by an Act of Parliament), NOT a constitutional body.
Questions frequently test the four core components of human rights under NHRC scope: life, liberty, equality, and dignity.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is a statutory body in India.
The commission is established to protect and promote human rights across the nation.
Human rights specifically encompass the rights to life, liberty, equality, and dignity.
These fundamental rights are guaranteed by the Constitution of India.
